title: The Professor's Alibi
synopsis: Carla says Professor Aldo came to her workshop on Tuesday too.
He wanted the piece. Did he take it?
It is time to check his story.
goal: Check Professor Aldo's story, and find out what he saw on Tuesday.

options.label: Yes. Aldo wears a yellow helmet.

play.title: Big Man, Small Man
story: Professor Aldo sits by a big fountain with four stone giants.
He is drawing in his green notebook again.
play.letter:
GIULIA'S NOTES — PROFESSOR ALDO RINALDI
He is small and thin.
He always wears a green hat.
His fingers are green with ink.
He was at the Bassi workshop on Tuesday afternoon.
play.question: Could Aldo be the man Pia saw on Thursday night?
hints: Read Pia's story again. What did the man look like?
Compare: big or small? Helmet or hat?
transition: Pia saw a big man in a yellow helmet. Aldo is small, with a green hat.
But Aldo still wanted the piece. Was he at the museum on Friday at midnight?
"Come to my hall," Aldo snaps. "I can prove where I was!"

clue.title: Not the Helmet Man
clue.note: Aldo does not look like the big man in the yellow helmet.

evidence.inscription: He is small and thin. He cannot lift heavy things.

play.title: The Door Log of Hall B
story: Hall B is a big room with rows of wooden seats.
A guard keeps a log by the door every night.
play.letter:
HALL B — FRIDAY NIGHT
11:15 PM — Prof. Rinaldi showed photos of old maps.
9:00 PM — Prof. Rinaldi started his talk.
1:00 AM — The talk ended. Prof. Rinaldi locked Hall B.
12:00 AM — Students asked questions. The professor answered for an hour.
play.question: Put Aldo's Friday night in order.
hints: PM times come before midnight. AM times come after it.
12:00 AM is midnight. 1:00 AM is one hour later.
play.successMessage: You put Aldo's night in order!
transition: At midnight on Friday, Aldo was answering questions in Hall B.
And Pia's Thursday man was big, not small and thin.
"So it was not me," says Aldo. Then, quietly: "But I saw something on Tuesday."
play.orderFeedback: Read the times again. Which ones are PM, and which are AM?

clue.title: Aldo's Friday Night

lines.text: You think I am a thief? Me?

discovery.title: IN HALL B AT MIDNIGHT
discovery.detail: Forty students saw Aldo at midnight. He did not carry the copy out.

Start at the last letter, B, and read to the left.

play.title: The Word in the Mirror
story: Back at the fountain, Aldo opens his notebook.
"On Tuesday, I went to Carla's workshop to buy a plaster lion for my class."
"A big man carried a box out. I saw it in her big mirror."
play.letter:
TUESDAY, BASSI WORKSHOP
A big man carried out a heavy box.
There was a word on the side of the box.
I saw it in the mirror, so it looked like this:
GNIDLIUB
A mirror turns words back to front.
play.question: What word was really on the box?
play.prompt: The word on the box was ____.
hints: Start at the last letter, B, and read to the left.
The word has to do with houses and walls.
transition: Read from the right end, GNIDLIUB is BUILDING.
A yellow helmet with a crane. A box that says BUILDING.
Aldo taps his pencil. "I think I know what kind of man he is."

feedback.GNIDLIUB: That is the word in the mirror. Read it from the right end.

play.orderFeedback: Those letters are right, but read them from the right end.

clue.title: The Mirror Word
clue.note: On Tuesday, the big man carried a box out of the Bassi workshop. It said BUILDING.

evidence.name: Aldo's Mirror Sketch

discovery.title: A BOX THAT SAYS BUILDING
discovery.detail: The big man's box came from a building company. What is his job?

notes: Letter: Aldo's question card putting the helmet, the crane and the box together. The man's job is a builder.

clueInputs.note: A yellow helmet with a crane on it.

learning.objective: 단서(안전모, 기중기, BUILDING 상자)를 종합해 직업 이름 builder를 만든다.

play.title: What Is His Job?
story: Aldo writes three lines on the big blackboard.
Under them, he draws seven empty boxes.
"A detective must put clues together," he says. "Go on."
play.letter:
THE MAN WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
1. A yellow helmet with a crane on it.
2. A heavy box with BUILDING on it.
3. Big, strong hands.

What is his job? A ________ builds houses, walls and roads.
play.question: Put the clues together. What is the man's job? Spell it.
hints: Who wears a helmet and works with cranes?
The job is made from the word build.
transition: Aldo was rude, but now he is on your side.
That night, an owl card slides under Giulia's door.
play.orderFeedback: All seven letters fit. A ____ builds houses.

evidence.name: Aldo's Old Photo
evidence.description: Aldo's photo of the real piece, on the day it was found. It shows a street, an owl and a crack.
evidence.inscription: The real piece has a crack shaped like a Y.

ending.text: A builder! Good. You think like a detective.
ending.speaker: aldo_rinaldi

ending.text: A copy would not have it. Let me help you.

play.caseSummary: Aldo is small and thin, and he was in Hall B all Friday night. He did not take the piece. On Tuesday, he saw a big man carry a BUILDING box out of the workshop. The man is a builder. Aldo's old photo shows the real piece's Y-shaped crack.

notes: Aldo is cleared here (his revealCase). From Case 09 he is the season's map expert.
Aldo's old photo (s3_ep06_e4) is how the real piece is told from a copy in Case 08 and Case 11.

STEP 3-14: puzzles kept; M1's letter no longer says the answer (Aldo is compared with Pia's man, not told he cannot lift). Both nights are now cleared in words: Thursday by Pia's description, Friday midnight by the Hall B log. Talks, Discovery Moments and an ending added.
